issue_request: FHIR-17780 was a Published Patient Care STU3 change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, to address a mismatch between the FamilyMemberHistory gender element name and a definition describing sex by renaming the element to sex while leaving the binding/code system/value set approach unchanged and updating the comment and requirements text to use sex/genetic sex language.
initial_application: The Jira snapshot records GitHub commit 04c4d675c5f4, which renamed the historical spreadsheet element and example XML from gender to sex and added the requested definition, comment, and requirements wording. Commit 984e2972b7e7 later fixed the FamilyMemberHistory search parameter from gender to sex. The 2021 source rework converted the resource source to structuredefinition-FamilyMemberHistory.xml while preserving the sex element and wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists familymemberhistory=FamilyMemberHistory, so the inspected FamilyMemberHistory source is in current build scope. Related FHIR-18850 was applied by the same historical commit and is already represented on the combined branch. Later FHIR-43360 resolved no-change and reaffirmed that Patient Care wanted the element to remain named sex. Later FHIR-55021 is a separate R6 Resolved-change-required follow-up to revise the sex definition/binding and add explanatory text; it is not yet Applied/Published and was treated as context rather than as source-edit scope for this seed.
reconciliation: No source change was made.
